This application is designed to support watchmen during their shifts by ensuring safety, accountability, and smooth operations.
It helps verify presence, track shift activity, enable rapid assistance, and maintain clear communication with the control center.
The system is built to protect both the watchman and the organization by ensuring accurate and fair reporting.

This system uses multiple verification methods to ensure accurate reporting during your shift.
Any attempts to manipulate location, movement, device behavior, or system signals may be automatically detected and reported to the control center.
The application is intended to assist you in completing your duties smoothly and should not be abused, spoofed, or tampered with.

During your shift, the application requires regular hourly check-ins to confirm your presence and activity.
You will be prompted to complete a check-in when required. These check-ins help ensure accurate attendance records and uninterrupted shift monitoring.

If an hourly check-in is missed, the system will record the event and notify the control center.
If a check-in is missed due to a valid reason, continue your duties normally and report the situation if required.
Repeated or unexplained missed check-ins may be reviewed by supervision.

Incident reporting allows you to document any unusual, unsafe, or important events during your shift.
If the appropriate incident type is not available in the list, select any option and clearly describe the situation in your own words.
Accurate incident reporting protects you and helps ensure proper action is taken.

The panic button is intended for genuine emergency situations where immediate assistance is required.
When activated, the system sends an urgent alert to the control center, shares your current location, and notifies your supervisor.
After activation, remain at your location and follow any instructions provided.

Panic alerts must only be used in legitimate emergency situations.
If a panic alert is triggered without a justified reason, the incident will be reviewed and appropriate administrative action may be taken in accordance with company policy.

During your shift, the device must remain powered on and the application must stay installed and active.
The application should not be force-closed, cleared, cached, or uninstalled. Installing additional applications or modifying device settings is not permitted.
Volume should remain at the highest level to ensure important announcements are heard. Device status, battery behavior, and usage outside the application may be monitored.
At the start of your shift, ensure the device is fully charged. Sudden or unusual battery drops may be reported.

You may receive announcements from the control center during your shift.
These announcements will be read aloud and may also appear as on-screen messages.
If the audio is unclear or missed, a written notification will be displayed. Please give full attention to all announcements, as they are specifically intended for you.
